newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Maystadt wants ASLK listing - agency.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Maystadt wants ASLK listing - agency.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt told Belgian parliament that the government wants to reduce the Belgian state's stake in ASLK-CGER bank to 25 percent and that it wants a bourse listing for the bank, Belgian news agency Belga said on Thursday.
Maystadt' press office could not immediately confirm or deny the Belga report.
The state sold 49.9 percent of ALSK to Belgian-Dutch insurance and banking group Fortis just over three years ago.

Fortis said earlier this month that it was in talks with the government about upping its stake. Fortis hopes the government will exercise a put option it holds on 9.8 percent of ASLK shares and sell a further 15 percent.
Belga quoted Maystadt as saying that it was not normal that one of Belgium's top five banks was not bourse-listed.
